ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖٓ اَنْ اَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qaumihī an anżir qaumaka min qabli ay ya'tiyahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD. We sent Noah unto his people. [saying:] "Warn thy people ere grievous suffering befall them!

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā qaumi innī lakum nażīrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And Noah] said: "O my people! I am but a plain warner to you, [sent to tell you]

ayahs.textArabic: اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوْهُ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ani‘budullāha wattaqūhu wa aṭī‘ūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: that you should worship God [alone] and be conscious of Him. "Now do pay heed unto me,

ayahs.textArabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّنْ ذُنُوْبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَاۤءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۘ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yagfir lakum min żunūbikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilā ajalim musammā(n), inna ajalallāhi iżā jā'a lā yu'akhkhar(u), lau kuntum ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that He may forgive you some of your sins, and grant you respite until a term known [to Him alone]: but, behold, when the term appointed by God does come, it can never be put back - if you but knew it!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِيْ لَيْلًا وَّنَهَارًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi innī da‘atu qaumī lailaw wa nahārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And after a time, Noah] said: "O my Sustainer! Verily, I have been calling unto my people night and day

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاۤءِيْٓ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Falam yazidhum du‘ā'ī illā firārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: but my call has only caused them to flee farther and farther away [from Thee].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنِّيْ كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْٓا اَصَابِعَهُمْ فِيْٓ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَاَصَرُّوْا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innī kullamā da‘autuhum litagfira lahum ja‘alū aṣābi‘ahum fī āżānihim wastagsyau ṡiyābahum wa aṣarrū wastakbarustikbārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And behold, whenever I called unto them with a view to Thy granting them forgiveness, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves up in their garments [of sin]; and grew obstinate, and became [yet more] arrogant in their false pride.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِنِّيْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma innī da‘autuhum jihārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And behold I called unto them openly;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِنِّيْٓ اَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَاَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ اِسْرَارًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma innī a‘lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum isrārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, behold I preached to them in public; and I spoke to them secretly, in private;

ayahs.textArabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Faqultustagfirū rabbakum innahū kāna gaffārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and I said: "'Ask your Sustainer to forgive you your sins - for, verily, He is all-forgiving!

ayahs.textArabic: يُّرْسِلِ السَّمَاۤءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yursilis-samā'a ‘alaikum midrārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: He will shower upon you heavenly blessings abundant,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْهٰرًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yumdidkum bi'amwāliw wa banīna wa yaj‘al lakum jannātiw wa yaj‘al lakum anhārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and will aid you with worldly goods and children, and will bestow upon you gardens, and bestow upon you running waters.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā lakum lā tarjūna lillāhi waqārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'What is amiss with you that you cannot look forward to God's majesty,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ اَطْوَارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qad khalaqakum aṭwārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: seeing that He has created [every one of] you in successive stages?

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara kaifa khalaqallāhu sab‘a samāwātin ṭibāqā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'Do you not see how God has created seven heavens in full harmony with one another,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيْهِنَّ نُوْرًا وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alal-qamara fīhinna nūraw wa ja‘alasy-syamsa sirājā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and has set up within them the moon as a light [reflected] and set up the sun as a [radiant] lamp?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ اَنْۢبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ نَبَاتًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ambatakum minal-arḍi nabātā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And God has caused you to grow out of the earth in [gradual] growth; and thereafter He will return you to it [in death]:

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُكُمْ فِيْهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ اِخْرَاجًا
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma yu‘īdukum fīhā wa yukhrijukum ikhrājā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [then] He will bring you forth [from It] in resurrection.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ بِسَاطًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ja‘ala lakumul-arḍa bisāṭā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "'And God has made the earth a wide expanse for you,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوْا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Litaslukū minhā subulan fijājā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that you might walk thereon on spacious paths.’"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِيْ وَاتَّبَعُوْا مَنْ لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗٓ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla nūḥur rabbi innahum ‘aṣaunī wattaba‘ū mal lam yazidhu māluhū wa waladuhū illā khasārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] Noah continued: "O my Sustainer! Behold, they have opposed me [throughout], for they follow people whose wealth and children lead them increasingly into ruin,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa makarū makran kubbārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and who have devised a most awesome blasphemy [against Thee],

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ەۙ وَّلَا يَغُوْثَ وَيَعُوْقَ وَنَسْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū lā tażarunna ālihatakum wa lā tażarunna waddaw wa lā suwā‘ā(n), wa lā yagūṡa wa ya‘ūqa wa nasrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: inasmuch as they said [to their followers], 'Do not ever abandon your gods: abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', and neither Yaghuth nor Ya’uq nor Nasr!'

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدْ اَضَلُّوْا كَثِيْرًا ەۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qad aḍallū kaṡīrā(n), wa lā tazidiẓ-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "And so they have led many a one astray: hence, ordain Thou that these evildoers stray but farther and farther away [from all that they may desire]!"

ayahs.textArabic: مِمَّا خَطِيْۤـٰٔتِهِمْ اُغْرِقُوْا فَاُدْخِلُوْا نَارًا ەۙ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَنْصَارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Mimmā khaṭī'ātihim ugriqū fa'udkhilū nārā(n), falam yajidū lahum min dūnillāhi anṣārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, because of their sins, they were drowned [in the great flood], and were doomed to suffer the fire [of the hereafter]; and they found none who could succour them against God.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qāla nūḥur rabbi lā tażar ‘alal-arḍi minal-kāfirīna dayyārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And Noah prayed: "O my Sustainer! Leave not on earth any of those who deny the truth:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكَ اِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْٓا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innaka in tażarhum yuḍillū ‘ibādaka wa lā yalidū illā fājiran kaffārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, If Thou dost leave them, they will [always try to] lead astray those who worship Thee, and will give birth to nothing but wickedness and stubborn ingratitude.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَّلِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِۗ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbigfir lī wa liwālidayya wa liman dakhala baitiya  mu'minaw wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt(i), wa lā tazidiẓ-ẓālimīna illā tabārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: "O my Sustainer! Grant Thy forgiveness unto me and unto my parents, and unto everyone who enters my house as a believer, and unto all believing men and believing women [of later times]; and grant Thou that the doers of evil shall increasingly meet with destruction!"'
